purpose: Produce deterministic, integrity-checked snapshot bundles for AI and human read-only consumption.
inputs: RM_project_files/ (working tree), manifest.json template, checksums.sha256 rules
implementation_notes: Rebuild is mechanical: update changed file hashes; do not change canonical semantics; keep sha256 null for manifest.json and checksums.sha256 in manifest files[]; exclude checksums.sha256 from checksums list.
non_functional: Deterministic output; zero checksum mismatches; reproducible build_utc recorded.
acceptance_criteria: checksums.sha256 reports 0 mismatches; manifest lists all files; AJ recorded in LOG_AJUSTES with evidence.
open_questions: Should build_utc be UTC or local? (current policy: UTC).
future_improvements: Add CI script that validates bundle before publish; add diff report per AJ; add size budget checks for legacy assets.

purpose: Ensure every AI agent reads data consistently and produces verifiable outputs.
outputs: Deterministic routines (AI_QUERY_PLAYBOOK) + output schema validation contract
implementation_notes: README is directive+mirror, never source of truth. Routines must be derivable from canonical files.
non_functional: No hardcoded counts in README; schema validation pass/fail.
acceptance_criteria: AI can locate canonical sources with zero ambiguity; output contract can be validated.
open_questions: Do we keep README en-US only or allow pt-BR mirror? (current: en-US only).
future_improvements: Add machine-readable 'canonical_index.json' listing all non-workbook canonical files; add automated README linter.

purpose: Define where and how game systems connect to data specs and Ruby scripts in RGSS.
outputs: Script architecture plan; module boundaries; naming conventions aligned with RMXP taxonomy
implementation_notes: Do not embed large manuals in canonical data; keep as LEGACY references. Prefer documenting decisions in GOV specs + LOG.
non_functional: Low coupling; predictable load order; stable save compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Each major system maps to a module and has trace links back to MER and FUNC specs.
open_questions: Which data loading strategy fits RMXP best (CSV parsed at boot vs precompiled)?
future_improvements: Create AI-only markdown extracts of RGSS/PDF manuals (chunked) with index; add code templates for RGSS classes.

purpose: Use external narrative references (e.g., Overlord) as guidance without embedding copyrighted text into canonical data.
outputs: Metadata-only index + AI digest summaries per chapter/illustration (no verbatim text); promptable narrative patterns
implementation_notes: Store external bundle pointer + sha256; generate summaries and pattern extraction only. Keep copyrighted content external and user-provided.
non_functional: No large binaries inside main snapshot; digest is searchable; citations point to external bundle entries.
acceptance_criteria: Index lists filenames + hashes + categories; digest provides pattern tags without reproducing text.
open_questions: Where will external bundle live long-term (Drive/Git LFS/local folder)?
future_improvements: Add chunk grid for narrative patterns; create 'scene recipe' templates derived from references.

purpose: Define audio mood guidance inspired by Radiohead without copying melodies/lyrics.
inputs: DATA/CORE/REFERENCIAS_MASTER.csv (Radiohead + albums entries); scene tags; act/area definitions
outputs: Mood map; instrumentation palette; procedural selection rules; composer brief
implementation_notes: Inspiration only; no copyrighted excerpts; define abstract attributes (tempo, texture, tension, warmth).
non_functional: Consistency across acts; dynamic layering; low memory footprint in RMXP.
acceptance_criteria: Every major area/quest has mood tags; soundtrack brief references only abstract traits.
open_questions: Will we ship original compositions only? (recommended: yes).
future_improvements: Define audio middleware-like mixing rules within RMXP; add test harness for looping/volume normalization.

purpose: Ensure Act 1 builds to a local executable for testing before any publication steps.
inputs: Game project folder; scripts; data snapshot; QA checklists
outputs: Local test executable; QA report; regression checklist
implementation_notes: Define pass/fail gates. Keep build steps documented and repeatable.
non_functional: Build in <= X minutes; deterministic packaging; crash-free boot.
acceptance_criteria: Executable launches; minimal playthrough passes; core systems verified.
future_improvements: Automate smoke tests; add save/load fuzz; create performance budget metrics.

purpose: Implement a deterministic walk/run modifier in RGSS with safe fallbacks (no asset hard-dependencies).
outputs: RM_MOVEMENT_RUN_RUNTIME (script) embedded in Scripts.rxdata; optional _run sprite behavior
implementation_notes: Run key: Input::SHIFT (fallback Input::A). Apply RUN_SPEED_DELTA = +1 to $game_player.move_speed while running. Optional sprite swap to "<base>_run" if file exists; otherwise keep original. Optional footsteps SE if present.
non_functional: No crashes if assets are missing; minimal patch surface; stable save/load compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Holding run key increases speed; releasing restores. No errors with missing sprites/SE. Works on fresh game + loaded save.
open_questions: Should run key and speed delta be configurable via data table or settings UI?
future_improvements: Externalize mapping to DATA/CORE/RMXP_INPUT_BINDINGS.csv and add settings UI; add stamina/encumbrance gating (future).

purpose: Add a pre-map character creation flow (Class + Antecedente) and persist selections into save data.
outputs: RM_CHARACTER_CREATE_RUNTIME (script) embedded in Scripts.rxdata; persisted keys in Game_System
implementation_notes: Hook Scene_Title#command_new_game abre Scene_CharacterCreate; UI carrega listas via RM_Data.csv_rows de ACT1_*_CANON; filtra antecedentes por REL_CLASS_ANTECEDENTE_CANON; persiste rm_class_key/rm_antecedente_id em Game_System; fallback para defaults se CSV ausente.
non_functional: Deterministic flow; stable save/load; no hard dependency on external CSV at boot.
acceptance_criteria: Sem crash na falta de CSV; nomes exibidos iguais ao DisplayName; filtro por classe respeita REL; confirmar volta ao mapa inicial mantendo seleção; save/load conserva campos rm_class_key/rm_antecedente_id.
open_questions: Integrar loadout inicial? Precisamos validar tradução/ícone antes do Ato 1 final?
future_improvements: Adicionar teste automatizado e cache de dados; mover para loader comum RM_Data com validação de colunas.

purpose: Detect drift against the frozen Act 1 content scope and surface mismatches (counts + canon references). Includes mode flag enforcement (STRICT/MILESTONE/OFF).
outputs: RM_QA/DATA/QA/RPT_ACT1_SCOPE_FREEZE_STATUS.csv (OK/WARN/ERROR); updated QA indices.; QA report must expose freeze mode and WARN when != STRICT
implementation_notes: Generate snapshot rule file in ACT1. In QA, compute: (1) count checks per frozen entity set; (2) reference checks (e.g., Quest.CapituloID in canon). Severity: ERROR blocks; WARN requires dedicated AJ; OK is informational. Add parse of MODE row from ACT1_SCOPE_FREEZE_CANON and propagate to report severity.
non_functional: Deterministic output; fast (CSV-only); no external dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Report generated; contains 0 ERROR for freeze compliance; WARN items documented and linked to follow-up AJs.
open_questions: Should CAP-0028 be canonized or remapped to CAP-0027? (requires decision + dedicated AJ).
future_improvements: Add per-entity diff listing new/removed IDs; integrate with build gate (FUNC_ACT1_LOCAL_BUILD). Track mode decisions per milestone (AJ_000369).

purpose: Load movement/run settings from external CSV for accessibility + tuning, with safe fallback defaults.
outputs: Overrides constants in RM_RunMovement at load time (HOLD/TOGGLE, key, speed delta, optional sprites/footsteps).
implementation_notes:
- Add CONFIG_CSV_REL/ALT paths.
- Parse simple CSV (key,value,type,notes); ignore blank/comment lines.
- Apply settings via const_set; warn-suppressed.
- Map run_key string to Input constant; SHIFT falls back to Input::A if SHIFT missing.
- Never crash if file is missing or malformed.
non_functional: Deterministic: defaults are embedded; CSV is optional. Robust: rescue exceptions; no hard dependency on CSV lib.
acceptance_criteria:
- Packer updates Scripts.rxdata with new RM_MOVEMENT_RUN_RUNTIME.
- Dist includes Data/RM_CSV/SETTINGS_MOVEMENT.csv.
- Game boots even if CSV is deleted.
open_questions:
- Should we validate allowed key names at load time and clamp speed delta?
- Should settings be versioned per Act build?
future_improvements:
- Introduce a generic SETTINGS loader used by multiple systems.
- Add an in-game Settings UI that edits this file (or saves to SaveData).

purpose: Carregar pools de encontros do Ato 1 e aplicar overrides por chunk no runtime.
implementation_notes: RGSS deve priorizar override por ChaveMapa e fallback para pool por MapType; validar IDs com ACT1_MONSTROS_CANON; tratar linhas vazias como ausência de spawn.
non_functional: Carregamento sem crash; weights normalizados; permite debug de quais entradas foram lidas.
acceptance_criteria: Boot no mapa não gera exceções; log de debug lista pools carregados; chunks sem entrada caem no pool de MapType.
open_questions: Adicionar cache e suporte a variação por horário/rep.

purpose: Carregar ACT1_LOOT_BY_CHUNK_CANON e expor loot por chunk no runtime.
outputs: Lista de itens por ChaveMapa com pesos e quantidades mín/max.
implementation_notes: RM_Loot tenta múltiplos caminhos (Data/RM_CSV, Data/ root, repo) via RM_Data.csv_rows; filtra por ChaveMapa; retorna lista vazia em caso de erro.
non_functional: Não gerar exceções se CSV ausente; leitura O(n) com cache simples possível em follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Call RM_Loot.loot_for_chunk("23T3") retorna 2 entradas; caminho ausente retorna [].
open_questions: Precisamos normalizar LootTableID vs nodes/monstros? Export RMXP automático?
future_improvements: Introduzir cache e validação de ItemID/Chunk contra dicionários.

purpose: Consumir passivas canônicas e regra de slot para equipar 1 passiva via RGSS.
outputs: rm_passive_equipped_id persistido no Game_System + UI com metadados
implementation_notes: Usar RM_Data.csv_rows, fallback seguro quando CSV ausente, exibir classe/tier/regra e registrar ajuda ao equipar.
non_functional: Compatível RGSS1; evitar travas em Input/Graphics loop.
acceptance_criteria: Lista carrega passivas do CSV; equipar mostra regra ativa; status exibe classe/tier/raridade; nenhum erro se CSV faltar.
open_questions: Como tratar passivas bloqueadas por classe?
future_improvements: Adicionar highlight por raridade e lock por class_key.
